skill.name: github-project-contributor-finder-api-skill
skill.description: Find GitHub repositories by keyword, star count, and update date, then return repository details and public contributor profile links through BrowserAct's hosted API workflow.
skill.summary: Search GitHub projects and public contributor profiles with BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill makes expected BrowserAct API calls, reads a BrowserAct API key, and documents a local Python command invocation. Most SKILL.md backtick findings are Markdown false positives, but credential handling and direct key-sharing guidance are real risks. No prompt injection attempt was found in the scanned files.

remediation.suggestion: Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY or a secure secret store, and redact secrets from logs.
Clearly state that search parameters and task requests are sent to BrowserAct. Ask for user consent before running networked collection tasks.
Add acceptable-use guidance for public data only, and prohibit spam, harassment, sensitive profiling, or bulk unsolicited outreach.
Keep invocation limited to the bundled Python script. Validate numeric arguments and avoid adding shell-interpreted user input.

content.user_title: Find GitHub Contributors by Project Signals
content.value_statement: Finding active GitHub projects and contributors can take hours of manual searching. This skill uses BrowserAct to search repositories, fetch metrics, and return contributor profile links.
actual_capabilities: Searches GitHub repositories by keyword, minimum stars, and last updated date.
Runs a BrowserAct hosted workflow through the bundled Python script.
Polls task status until the BrowserAct workflow finishes or times out.
Returns repository names, URLs, owners, descriptions, and star counts.
Returns public contributor profile links, bios, websites, and Twitter handles.
Reports missing keys, invalid authorization, task failures, and concurrent task limits.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account and a valid BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Sends search parameters and task requests to BrowserAct's external API.
Results depend on public GitHub data and BrowserAct workflow availability.
Long searches can take several minutes and may hit account limits.

use_cases.title: Source Open-Source Candidates
use_cases.description: Find contributors to active repositories in a specific technical area and review their public profile links.

use_cases.title: Map Developer Communities
use_cases.description: Identify repositories, owners, and active contributors around a language, framework, or developer tool category.

use_cases.title: Research Project Ecosystems
use_cases.description: Collect repository metrics and contributor profiles for market research, partnership scouting, or open-source analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Project Leads
prompt_templates.prompt: Find GitHub repositories about browser automation with at least 100 stars. Return repository details and contributor profile links.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for React framework repositories updated after 2025-06-01 with at least 1000 stars. Limit results to one page.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Contributor Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find active contributors in machine learning repositories with at least 500 stars. Summarize profiles, websites, and social handles.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Developer Markets
prompt_templates.prompt: Run separate searches for browser automation and testing frameworks. Compare repository activity, owners, and contributor outreach opportunities.

output_examples.input: Find browser automation repositories with at least 100 stars.
output: Repository results include names, URLs, owners, descriptions, and star counts.
Contributor results include GitHub profiles, bios, public websites, and Twitter handles when available.

output_examples.input: Search React framework projects updated after 2025-06-01.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a concise research summary with matching repositories, public contributor profiles, and available contact links.

output_examples.input: Find machine learning contributors for developer relations outreach.
output_examples.output: The response lists relevant projects first, then highlights contributors with profile context for careful manual review.

best_practices: Use narrow keywords and realistic star thresholds to keep searches relevant.
Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through a secure environment variable before running the script.
Review public profile data manually before any recruiting, outreach, or research use.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not use the output for spam, harassment, or sensitive profiling.
Do not request broad scraping when a focused repository search would answer the question.

faq.question: What account is required?
faq.answer: You need a BrowserAct account with a valid API key stored as BROWSERACT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Does this skill call GitHub directly?
faq.answer: No. The bundled script sends workflow requests to BrowserAct, which performs the hosted collection task.

faq.question: What data can the skill return?
faq.answer: It can return repository details and public contributor profile information such as bios, websites, and Twitter handles.

faq.question: How long can a task take?
faq.answer: The script can poll for up to 15 minutes while the BrowserAct workflow runs.

faq.question: Can I control result size?
faq.answer: Yes. Use page count and per-page limits to control the amount of data requested.

faq.question: What privacy care is needed?
faq.answer: Use only public profile data, respect platform rules, and avoid unsolicited bulk outreach.
